AOBP Dev-Server Handover

Everything needed to install the module on the REDCap development server and work through the tests that only a real REDCap can answer. Two of them can invalidate the rest, so they come first.

1 September 2026 module v1.0.0 harness build 1.7.21 framework v15

What you're getting

utas_aobp_integration_v1.0.0.zip

The external module — 29 files, 169 kB. Contains AobpIntegration.php, config.json, js/ (the survey-page controller) and sdk/ (the BP+ JavaScript SDK, 24 modules). The README inside covers the instrument contract, the device clock, transports and the raw XML in full.

AOBPDEV_DataDictionary_2026-08-31_extended.csv

Your 31 August dictionary with the changes listed below — 155 fields, no duplicate IDs. Your original file is untouched on our side.

Install

  1. Unzip into REDCap's modules/ directory. Keep the folder name utas_aobp_integration_v1.0.0 — REDCap reads the version from it.
  2. Enable the module on the project.
  3. Set the project settings below.
SettingFor tomorrowWhy
Instrument that carries the AOBP controls aobp_visit Default; set it only if the instrument is named differently
Store the raw measurement XML as a file on The whole point of steps 3–5
Log every serial line to the browser console on Troubleshooting only — turn it off afterwards
Show warnings on measurements that succeeded off Default. The device retries and recovers on its own; those warnings fire over good readings with nothing to act on

Import the dictionary

Six of your fields changed content and three were renamed. The renames are descriptive fields only — no data is stored in them — but check nothing else in the project references the old names before importing.

ChangeFieldsReason
Element IDs suffixed connect-bp-btn → connect-bp-btn-seated / -standing
status-display → status-display-seated / -standing		 Both blocks are on one page with the same IDs, so getElementById returned the seated controls for both and the standing block never responded
Renamed aobp_instruct_seat1 → aobp_instruct_seated_only
aobp_instruct_seat2 → aobp_instruct_seated_then_standing
aobp_instruct_stand → aobp_instruct_standing		 seat1/seat2 gave no clue which was which; the pair differ by one sentence, the one warning the patient that standing follows
Removed repeat_btn, repeat_btn_standing Repeat Measurement ran the identical call as Start. Start now renames itself to Repeat Seated BP once that position has a reading — one control per position, saying what pressing it will do
Added seated_cancel_btn, standing_cancel_btn
ui_alerts_seated, ui_alerts_standing
ui_visit_state_seated, ui_visit_state_standing		 Cancel while a measurement is running; the device's own account of a measurement; and what the visit still needs

One observation, unchanged from your file: seated_unfinished and standing_unfinished have empty field labels. If REDCap rejects the import, that is the first place to look.

The tests

In this order. Steps 1 and 2 are the ones no amount of testing here can settle, and either can invalidate what follows.

1

Does save-xml survive a survey page?

Open the instrument as a survey, not as a data-entry form, and take one seated measurement with the BP+ connected.

expect

A file appears on seated_raw_xml, roughly 125 kB.

if not

The browser console carries the reason. The likely one is that the AJAX action must be declared for a context where the respondent is not a logged-in user — see below.

2

Is the file on the right record and instance?

aobp_visit is a repeating instrument. The module hands REDCap whatever redcap_module_ajax supplies for $record, $event_id and $repeat_instance, and a file cannot attach to a record that does not exist yet.

expect

The filename says so: 1001_inst2_seated_aobp.xml on instance 2, attached to instance 2.

if not

Note which is wrong — record, event or instance. Each has a different fix.

3

Does the marker replace the XML?

REDCap keeps only the first part of a value that long, so what sat in seated_raw_xml_text was a fragment of an XML document formatted to look like a whole one. Once the file is stored, the field is replaced. 

stored-as-file field=seated_raw_xml filename=1001_inst1_seated_aobp.xml
  bytes=125768 sha256=6820f666… at=2026-09-01T09:14:02.881Z
expect

That line, and nothing else, in the text field.

then

Download the file and check it: certutil -hashfile 1001_inst1_seated_aobp.xml SHA256. It should match the marker exactly — that is the point of the digest.

4

What happens when the upload fails?

Take a measurement with the network briefly stopped — DevTools ▸ Network ▸ Offline is the cleanest way — then bring it back.

expect

A red line: "The seated measurement is saved, but its full recording did not reach the server. Press Resend recording. Do not close this page until it succeeds." — and a Resend recording button beneath it. Pressing it after the network returns stores the file and writes the marker.

note

The numbers are safe either way; they are written before the upload is attempted. The recording is what is at risk, and it exists nowhere but that browser tab until it uploads.

5

A full visit, seated and standing

With dizz or faint set so standing is required, run the whole thing: connect, seated, standing, and check the fields.

expect

Two files, two markers, both averages, both heart rates, and the visit reporting itself complete.

6

A device that is not in AOBP mode

New behaviour, and worth seeing once so it is not mistaken for a fault. A BP+ in suprasystolic mode measures something else entirely — a central pressure waveform from one inflation, not the three-reading average this study records — and a reading taken that way lands in seated_ave_sys looking exactly like a protocol one.

expect

Start is refused, not warned about: "BP+ connected, but it is not in AOBP mode. Press Set AOBP mode to switch it." Set AOBP mode and Ping stay live, because gating the button that fixes the mode on already being in that mode would leave every control dead.

If step 1 fails

Most likely cause. The External Modules framework treats a survey respondent as unauthenticated, and an AJAX action may have to be declared before it can be called from there. If the console shows the request rejected rather than a REDCap::saveFile error, try adding this to config.json beside "framework-version": 

"no-auth-ajax-actions": ["save-xml"],

We have not been able to verify that key name against your framework version — please check it against the documentation for the REDCap you are running rather than taking it from us.

The other possibility is \REDCap::saveFile() itself. That call, with its ten positional arguments, is the one from your aobp_integration_v1.0.1/ajax.php — we kept it rather than substituting our own guess, but we have never seen it run. If it is the wrong method for this REDCap version, REDCap::addFileToField() is the first alternative to try.

Fields the module writes that the instrument doesn't have

Two, and they need a decision rather than a fix. The module writes them and logs a console warning when the field is absent; nothing breaks.

FieldWhat it carriesDecision
seated_snr
standing_snr		 Signal-to-noise ratio for the determination, as the device reports it Add as numeric fields, or we drop them. Worth having: it is the one number that separates a clean measurement from a marginal one, and the context is otherwise lost when the XML leaves the page

Decided, 1 September

Four questions from the earlier list, settled with Richard. Three are now the module's behaviour; one removed a feature.

Failed measurements are not recorded as failures

The operator can simply try again, and the buttons stay live. The study does not want a stored record of an attempt that produced nothing, and the flexible version is the one that is easy to explain to clinic staff.

The three-second auto-advance is gone

Removed from the module, its two project settings, the harnesses and the README — not left behind a checkbox. It came from v1.0.1 and inflated the cuff three seconds after the seated measurement whether or not the participant was upright. A measurement that starts before the person is standing is not a standing measurement.

Measurements started on the device stay cancelled

Confirmed as correct. One begun with the BP+'s own Start button carries no patient ID and belongs to no record, though the device stores it anyway.

Completion comes from the calc field

The module no longer writes sys_measurement_status. sys_measurement_complete derives completion from the readings themselves, so there is one answer instead of two that can disagree.

A working copy of the instrument, with a stand-in for this module, runs at utas.centralbp.com/test/harness-visit.html — the page reports its build number in the banner, and every measurement path above has been exercised there against both a simulator and a real BP+. What it cannot exercise is REDCap itself, which is what tomorrow is for.
